answer: A mesa voyage milestone bond stops fakes. Each agent stakes a 70-credit jade bond and files a key-signed milestone per waypoint on its voyage. Auditors replay the public mesa route table and burn bonds for missing or reused ones. First filing 35, kth 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented-milestone rings fail: one jade seal binds one key per waypoint. Honest agents file once, pay 35, keep the bond.
